sentences.text:
Petition
 Through: Ms. Shivanjali Bhalerao, Advocate
 versus
 State Of Nct Of Delhi And Anr .....Responde
 Through: Si Ashish, Ps Rajouri Garden.
 Mr. Vishesh Wadhwa and Mr.
 Shivam Dahiya, Advocate for R-
 Coram:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 942/2023 of PS Rajouri Garden for offence under Section 354/380/506/509/34 IPC on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for petitioners that on the complaint lodged by the present petitioner no.1, another FIR for offence under Section 498A/406 IPC was registered and for quashing thereof separate petition has been filed.
4.
